name: agent-skills (Addy Osmani)
hook: 117.5k stars and still climbing. Google Chrome DevTools lead Addy Osmani built 25 lifecycle skills that map straight to how senior engineers actually ship code: define → plan → build → verify → review → ship, each with checklists, verification gates, and 9 slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship, and three more). name: Agentic Awesome Skills (AAS Core)
hook: 49.7k stars, v20.8.0, 2,957+ SKILL.md playbooks organized into bundles (role-based groupings) and workflows (ordered playbooks), plus 13 specialized plugins covering Web App Builder, Security Engineer, Data Analytics, DevOps & Cloud, and more. name: claude-code-templates (davila7)
hook: 33.6k stars, updated Nov 13. An open-source registry + zero-install CLI for Claude Code components: 1,980 items across 918 skills, 422 agents, 288 commands, 119 MCP servers, 80 settings, 63 hooks, 50 mods, and more—all browsable at aitmpl.com. The CLI writes each file to its correct location and merges with existing config instead of overwriting. Includes a local analytics dashboard, conversation browser, and health-check diagnostic. name: Planning with Files
hook: 28.1k stars, Manus-style file-based planning for long-running agents. Keeps three markdown files in the project (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) and uses lifecycle hooks to re-inject the plan every turn, so it survives /clear, context compaction, and crashes. A gated mode holds the agent from stopping mid-phase; SHA-256 attestation refuses to inject a plan whose contents were modified outside the session. Direct cost benefit: persistent context means no token-burning re-discovery after a session reset.
